summary: The PR fixes a long-standing issue with the Bareiss algorithm, but introduces a new complexity and may have performance implications.

issues.description: The change introduces a new complexity by using a custom iszerofunc, which may have performance implications and is not thoroughly tested.
The change does not add any new tests to cover the new complexity, which may lead to behavioral regression risk.
The change uses a custom iszerofunc, which is not a standard approach in SymPy and may not be consistent with the project conventions.
The change may have performance implications due to the use of a custom iszerofunc, which may lead to a performance regression.
